right_run: Hold Right and B; release A. Use on supported floor when no immediate hazard is ahead. This action keeps Mario at floor height and cannot jump over an approaching enemy. If a live same-height enemy is closing, choose a moving jump while space remains; continuous floor does not make this action safe. An isolated overhead tile with empty space beneath it is passable. When standing on a raised surface with continuous lower floor immediately beyond its edge, run off and land on that floor if the drop is safe.
right_run_jump: Hold Right, B and A for a needed moving jump. When grounded with a live same-height enemy closing ahead, jump while space remains. If contact is approaching in roughly 10–20 frames and raised tiles lie farther ahead, consider jumping before entering their span rather than running beneath all of them. Also jump when a solid ground-level wall or pipe blocks forward travel, or shortly before a floor gap with a visible landing bank. Keep A held during ascent when height is needed. A floating tile with open space beneath it is not a ground-level wall. If Mario stands on a raised surface and continuous lower floor extends from its edge, run off and land on that floor before choosing a jump for a later gap. Pressing A while already falling cannot start a new jump.
right: Hold only Right; release both B and A. Advance at lower speed when a careful approach or jump release is useful.
right_jump: Hold Right and A; release B. Move right through a slower jump when a visible hazard requires it.
left: Hold only Left; release both B and A. Brake or retreat when continuing right would be unsafe.
left_jump: Hold Left and A; release B. Use only when an immediate visible hazard makes moving right unsafe and jumping while retreating provides a safe path. On an open route to the right, this action slows or reverses progress. If already airborne with A held, it cannot start another jump.
wait: Release all buttons to stop or let Mario settle when movement would be unsafe.
jump: Hold only A; release Left, Right and B. Use a jump in place only when a visible immediate hazard makes horizontal movement unsafe and rising helps avoid it. This action gives no rightward acceleration. On clear continuous floor it leaves Mario at the same x; choose a right-moving action. While airborne it cannot start a new jump.
